goal: Prevent crashes and unintended side effects when users pass negated startup arguments like -nofoo or -foo=0
Stop negated options from executing commands named '0', setting insecure passwords, or misconfiguring networks
agreement: Concept approval noting that surprising negation behaviors were previously documented (l0rinc)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes a pervasive hazard where negating options led to crashes and unintended behavior
Eliminates assertion crashes in the mempool graph and unexpected connections caused by argument parsing
